name: bilinear

test_list.description: Validated bilinear interpolation reproduces all four corners.
Degenerate axes and out-of-range queries fail with a typed error.
Finite in-domain values produce finite outputs or an explicit overflow error.

inputs.name: grid
inputs.description: Increasing x/y axes and row-major finite corner values.

output_description: A finite bilinear interpolation value or typed error.
